description: a signal to itself reaches listeners under any name of its number (SIGABRT/SIGIOT), each under its own name
argv: process.on('SIGIOT', (n, num) => console.log('IOT', n, num)); process.on('SIGABRT', (n, num) => console.log('ABRT', n, num)); console.log(process.kill(process.pid, 'SIGABRT'), process.kill(process.pid, 6)); setTimeout(() => {}, 30)
